name: 11221 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11221 (Brooklyn) has 254 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11221 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
